answer: One workable design: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because walnut only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, karst is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any falcon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
